text:
anne (docs): Quick heads-up — we've published a new developer guidelines + sample code policy for SDK/docs that applies to all repos that ship example snippets or quickstarts. Link: https://internal.redwood/example-policy (TL;DR below)

sam (devex): Nice. TL;DR?

anne (docs): TL;DR: 1) Code examples must include a one-line license header and inline comment about data/telemetry behavior; 2) Snippets that make network calls must use ephemeral keys in examples or mock/stub in tests; 3) We now require a single-file quickstart for each SDK (<= 30 lines where possible); 4) Small policy: samples that persist logs/telemetry need an opt-in flag and a clear doc note.

jason (sdk): Do we have a migration window for existing repos?

anne (docs): Yes — 60 days for non-sensitive repos, 90 days if you need legal review. We've listed repo owners in the doc. If you need an exception, ping me with a short justification.

kevin (eng): For the one-line header, is there a canonical template? e.g., // Redwood sample — MIT?

lucy (legal): Prefer: // Redwood sample — license: MIT OR BSD-3 (explicit). We want a consistent pattern so automated scans can pick it up. Docs page includes exact snippets to copy.

jason (sdk): About telemetry: the SDK has an opt-out ENV var today. Do you want explicit opt-in in examples?

anne (docs): For examples that surface any call metadata (latency, token counts) please show how to enable/disable telemetry and default to disabled in quickstarts. The policy says examples must not silently send telemetry.

deploy-bot: build-checks/scan: Fixed-rule check added for sample-header and telemetry-flag. First enforcement run scheduled: +7 days.

sam (devex): We'll update the quickstarts template and add a lint rule in the SDK repo to surface missing headers. Can we get a list of top-10 repos to prioritize?

anne (docs): Added an ordered list in the doc (top-10 by downloads + internal usage). I'll post the list in #devex-ops in 1h.

kevin (eng): Any change to the code of conduct for publishing community examples?

lucy (legal): No change to CoC. This policy only affects license and telemetry disclosures. If a community contrib requires a different license, follow the contribution checklist in the doc.

jason (sdk): Plan for SDK release to include the lint rule and quickstart template in next patch (v4.2.1). ETA: 2 business days.

sam (devex): I'll coordinate a small GA email to customers and update the public docs once internal enforcement is live. Also will add a migration checklist for maintainers.

anne (docs): Thanks all. Action items in the doc: 1) SDK: add lint + template (jason), 2) Docs: publish migration checklist + repo owners (anne), 3) DevEx: prioritize top-10 (sam), 4) Legal: rapid-review queue for exceptions (lucy). We'll re-run enforcement scans after 30 days and then after 60 days before blocking. 

anne (docs): If you have any questions or see anything missing, reply here or DM me. :heart:
